name: Editor import military operations axes 1544–1549 based on PR41 source-anchored routes

metadata.source_warning: HES official Pinkie BTL15 and HES 2025 Dunglass SOS p.6–7 and p.19–20; HES 2022 Haddington communications and French cavalry blockade
metadata.geometry_policy: ALL 6 features are non-surveyed LineString geographic reference axes; NEVER political control/actual war damage polygons
metadata.old_version_replaced: 4 invented broad Polygon/MultiPolygon sketches; intentionally deleted as unsupported and partly detached from England
metadata.road_caveat: HES Dunglass Statement describes possible 1547 crossing c.1 mile upstream, and later relocation toward modern A1. Do NOT trace present A1 as Tudor survey.
metadata.England_reference_geo_source: data/modern-uk-regions.topojson North East coarse political region polygon: route first node is INSIDE England and following segment crosses into Scotland, no visual gap
metadata.fort_continuity: English garrison nodes are independently attested. No arbitrary polygon union or point buffers.
metadata.French_blockade: HES Haddington French-Scottish cavalry interdicted supply; no continuous secure English pocket from Dunglass to Haddington under siege
metadata.Hailes: Scots recovered 1548, not included in English secure occupation band
metadata.end_year_1549: Haddington English ceased by September 1549; no 1549 year-end link to Haddington
metadata.chief_editor: Replace main outdated four guess-made Polygon/MultiPolygon war reach with these five source-backed LineString references; integrate with map territory toggle

properties.name: 1544年英军自利斯登陆袭击爱丁堡（不与英格兰陆上疆域相连）
properties.controller: English military movement or garrison contact, sovereignty Scottish
properties.route_continuity_certainty: HES confirms assault via Leith; modern intermediate geometry schematic
properties.scene_notes: Never connect this 1544 seaborne raid to Berwick or infer Edinburgh was held by England year-end.
properties.summary_zh: 1544年英国海军从利斯方向协助进攻并焚毁爱丁堡，是短时突袭，不是沿陆路从贝里克打通的占领走廊，也不能涂成1544年末英属爱丁堡。
properties.precision_note: 示意折线依据史料所述起点、经过的城镇/要塞及行军方向布置，所有中间折点是现代地图上的粗略视觉引导，绝非1540年代实际道路测绘；线宽为屏幕像素，不对应英军控制土地的真实宽度。
properties.map_disclaimer: 有文献依据的历史进军／军堡通讯方向示意，线条和宽度均非精确军事控制边界。

properties.name: 1547年贝里克至平基战场的沿东海岸英军进军路线（非持续占地）
properties.controller: English military movement or garrison contact, sovereignty Scottish
anchors: historic Pease crossing near Dunglass, exact unverified
properties.route_continuity_certainty: HES confirms from Berwick along east coast with fleet and crossing inland near Dunglass; intermediate route NOT modern A1
properties.scene_notes: Battlefield sources support advance axis, not garrison control every village. Some sources have pursuit almost to Edinburgh, city not captured.
properties.summary_zh: 苏格兰历史环境局记载，萨默塞特于1547年9月自贝里克沿东海岸进军，舰队在海上配合并帮助补给，英军经邓格拉斯一带进至平基战场。邓格拉斯原古道过溪地点仍有争论，绘出的线仅表示由南到北的战役方向，不是具体可通行的1547古道，更不代表全程土地被英国驻军治理。
properties.precision_note: 示意折线依据史料所述起点、经过的城镇/要塞及行军方向布置，所有中间折点是现代地图上的粗略视觉引导，绝非1540年代实际道路测绘；线宽为屏幕像素，不对应英军控制土地的真实宽度。

properties.name: 1548年贝里克—埃茅斯附近—邓格拉斯英军守备交通轴线（概略）
properties.controller: English military movement or garrison contact, sovereignty Scottish
properties.route_continuity_certainty: HES Dunglass PDF p.19-20 says fort guarded Haddington communication; not evidence of continuous protected English villages along length
properties.scene_notes: Route begins inside mapped English North East region so the visual violet reach touches purple kingdom; moderate shading does not mean property occupation.
properties.summary_zh: 英国统治的贝里克从边境延伸的东海岸交通和埃茅斯、邓格拉斯英军据堡为向哈丁顿提供支援的作战体系。HES的邓格拉斯城堡考察特别证实1548年英军工事守护哈丁顿通讯线路，但并不证明路线上所有土地、乡村都长期英占。这条半透明紫色线与英格兰本土相接，只是视觉上呈现交通方向。
properties.precision_note: 示意折线依据史料所述起点、经过的城镇/要塞及行军方向布置，所有中间折点是现代地图上的粗略视觉引导，绝非1540年代实际道路测绘；线宽为屏幕像素，不对应英军控制土地的真实宽度。

properties.name: 1548年邓格拉斯至哈丁顿：遭苏法封锁的军事补给方向
properties.controller: English military movement or garrison contact, sovereignty Scottish
anchors: Haddington English-garrisoned fortress under Franco-Scottish siege
properties.route_continuity_certainty: HES Haddington says French/Scottish cavalry stopped supplies reaching town; inferred geographic line only, not an actually safe road
properties.scene_notes: Not an area of uninterrupted English military control. Keep a gap in solid coloration; purple-and-blue dashes denote contested access near Dunbar, Haddington.
properties.summary_zh: 哈丁顿虽有英军驻守，苏法联军于1548年围城，其骑兵在周围乡野活动并阻止补给。邓格拉斯为通讯堡不代表哈丁顿一路畅通。此处明确以较轻蓝紫虚线表示受威胁的交通/争夺方向，而非连续英占道路。
properties.precision_note: 示意折线依据史料所述起点、经过的城镇/要塞及行军方向布置，所有中间折点是现代地图上的粗略视觉引导，绝非1540年代实际道路测绘；线宽为屏幕像素，不对应英军控制土地的真实宽度。

properties.name: 1549年哈丁顿撤军后：贝里克至邓格拉斯边境英军守备轴线
properties.controller: English military movement or garrison contact, sovereignty Scottish
properties.route_continuity_certainty: HES Dunglass 1549 commander Sep 25 and 27 letters prove ongoing English camp; no evidence precise military occupation along road
properties.scene_notes: Lauder is independent separately sourced fort icon; no fictitious branch from main lane. Haddington 1549 end-year is Scottish.
properties.summary_zh: 1549年9月英军离开哈丁顿；HES邓格拉斯纪要记录英军将领9月仍在修筑守备工事。地图只保留贝里克—埃茅斯附近—邓格拉斯这一概略军事交通轴，不再假画通向哈丁顿的紫色占领带。劳德尔有独立英军据堡，但缺乏可证持续供给路线，仍保持孤立据点。

properties.name: 1544年英军自爱丁堡往邓巴方向的沿岸袭掠地理关系（概略）
properties.controller: Hertford English raid within independent Scotland
properties.route_continuity_certainty: HES documents raids and southward English withdrawal; exact sequence through Preston Tower and specific 1544 roads unverified. Intermediate visual bends are invented for schematic orientation only.
properties.summary_zh: 赫特福德英军在1544年焚掠爱丁堡，并破坏普雷斯顿塔与邓巴等东洛锡安据点。这条线仅把同一场行动中可证的具名地点连成读者用的方向关系，不主张英军一定按照所有折点逐站行军，更不说明整条路有安全或长期英国军管。
properties.precision_note: 线为非实测军事行动示意；与现代地面道路、实际行军距离、焚毁房屋范围、领土面积没有直接对应。普雷斯顿和邓巴的具体当日行动次序仍须进一步核实。
properties.map_disclaimer: 苏格兰独立主权未变，英军1544年短期纵火袭扰并非军占带。
properties.source_precision: HES historic campaign narrative and named building heritage records
